name: salvo
description: One pass is a guess; a salvo is a measurement — N independent passes fired in parallel, merged by pure rules: intersection (/salvo:spec-gate), union (/salvo:sweep), consensus (/salvo:vet), plus /salvo:spec and always-on discipline hooks, and /salvo:leg — a 3-4 task autonomous leg that stops at the user's preference fork with a plain-language handoff
